payrollMock.title: Payroll management — design proposal
payrollMock.sub: Possible screens aligned with Fabrika ERP HR UI (mockup only)
payrollMock.cardPeriodDesc: Month close, lock, payment date and period FX are managed here.
payrollMock.cardLinesDesc: Monthly wage, attendance, leave and deductions; net amounts must stay consistent with the central wage engine.
payrollMock.flow1: 1. Data capture — attendance and leave are frozen for the locked period.
payrollMock.flow2: 2. Calculation — tax, social security and advance deductions are applied.
payrollMock.flow3: 3. Review — HR and accounting perform a four-eyes check.
payrollMock.flow4: 4. Approval and payment — manager sign-off, bank file and GL posting.
payrollMock.cardFxDesc: FX for official vs unofficial components at period time; later tied to a stored period FX rate.
payrollMock.cardAuditDesc: Who changed what and when; prior net values; export and approval logs.
payrollMock.footerNote: This page is for product design only; figures are sample and buttons perform no action.
payrollMock.cardDisputeDesc: Requests are checked against attendance and leave records; an approved fix updates the source entry, the payroll line is recalculated, and the previous version is kept in the audit trail. Not every worker has a self-service profile: HR users with payroll management permission may also create disputes and edit records within their authority.
payrollMock.disp1.desc: May 12 overtime 17:00–20:00 is missing from the payroll.
payrollMock.disp2.desc: May 19 is not counted as an accrual day; I was on shift that day.
payrollMock.cardDayBreakdownDesc: The day-by-day attendance behind a payroll line. Missing days or missing overtime are flagged here; the fix happens on the monthly attendance record and payroll is recalculated.
payrollMock.fixFlow1: 1. The request is opened from the worker’s profile or attendance self-service, or—when no profile exists—by HR from the payroll/disputes screen; day, issue type and description are captured.
payrollMock.fixFlow2: 2. HR cross-checks attendance and leave records and confirms with the shift supervisor if needed. HR users with management permission may update the source records when the process requires it.
payrollMock.fixFlow3: 3. For approved disputes the source record (attendance row / overtime) is updated — the payroll line is never edited directly.
payrollMock.fixFlow4: 4. The payroll line is automatically recalculated by the central wage engine; a new version (v2, v3…) is created and the previous calculation lands in the audit trail.
payrollMock.fixFlow5: 5. The difference is either folded into the same payroll or paid in the next period as a top-up line.
payrollMock.policy1: Dispute window: 5 working days after payroll publication.
payrollMock.policy2: During the window the period stays partially locked; only dispute-driven fixes are accepted.
payrollMock.policy3: After the window the period is fully locked; later corrections appear in the next period as a top-up or deduction.
payrollMock.policy4: Every revision is written to audit_log with who/when/why.
